breakdown.description: The follower hole pressure is replaced by a dead load using the reference normal
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the error from the incomplete prompt. It states 'apply a dead pressure load using the reference (undeformed) outward normal N of the hole boundary' and computes N_ref as a fixed reference-configuration normal expression. This directly contradicts the ground truth, which requires the hole load to be applied as a follower pressure using the current normal of the deformed configuration.
